About Us:
 LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.

 Role Description:
 Do you have a passion for technology? Do you want to learn and make a difference in financial markets infrastructure? We’re building a new engineering team, and we’re looking for passionate, hands-on technologists to help us lead the way.
 CDSClear IT is the team behind the technology powering CDSClear – a critical clearing service within the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG).
We are looking for a highly skilled Quality Assurance Engineer to design, develop and complete tests for Web UIs and Web Services supporting our clearing service. The role is part of the build out of a new team based in Bucharest. The new team will collaborate with colleagues in London and Paris to deliver innovative solutions. You will learn how to deliver in a commercially focussed financial services business in a phase of expansion.
 Key Responsibilities:
Take ownership within the end-to-end software delivery lifecycle, using Agile or traditional methodologies as needed.
Developing new functional and non-functional tests to run fully automatically in testing pipelines from GitLab.
When required due to complexity or cross platform requirements, Engineer and execute tests in integrated test environments.
Ensure test execution status and evidence captured in Test Management system (e.g. Zephyr)
Analyse test breaks and raise defects within tracking tool (e.g. JIRA).
Collaborate with global teams to understand requirements, complete test design, implement tests and diagnose the root cause of defects.
Champion automation, from testing to deployment, to ensure speed and quality.
Work within a regulated financial environment, with a strong focus on cybersecurity and production controls.
 Candidate Profile / Key Skills:
Practical experience at designing automated tests for Web UIs and ideally Web Services.
Expert level skills with test automation frameworks such as Cucumber.
Practical experience with UI Testing frameworks (e.g. Cypress) for automated testing of Web Applications.
Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.
Linux skills suitable for executing applications, manipulating files (config/test data) and analysing system outputs such as logs and reports.
 It would help us if you have:
Understanding of Java-based backend services (Spring Boot, microservices architecture).
Experience engineering pipelines in CI/CD tools to execute test environment setup and to execute tests.
SQL skills suitable for querying Oracle databases to verify system outputs.
 Why Join Us?
Be part of a global mission with real impact in the financial markets.
Help influence the shape of a new team and culture in Bucharest from the ground up.
Work with innovative technologies in a modern cloud environment.
Enjoy a flexible, hybrid work model and a supportive, inclusive culture.
Access to career development, training, and international opportunities within LSEG.
